name: type
title: Type tier
description: Words set in the world, still real text: lay a heading and a paragraph into a drawn surface's real shape (a board, an arch, a slanted sign), one width per line; shrink-wrap and balance a card; fit the largest legible size or hand the words back to the flat reading; and place one DOM span per line, with the line boxes in the scene's logical units for calm and contrast. Loaded lazily; built on Pretext (decision 0019).

budget.reason: A pure layout core (layout.js) and its DOM edge (lines, junctions and surfaces), budgeted apart from Pretext's own bytes (decisions 0010 and 0019).
